verdict.rationale: SoloKeys' own site gives minimal first-party setup steps: insert the key into any USB port with no software or drivers, then touch the capacitive sensor when prompted. That is only a glancing outline, not a guided walkthrough for registering the key with accounts. Missing for 10: a setup app or wizard, step-by-step per-account enrollment guides (e.g. Google, GitHub), PIN setup and backup-key guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration that setup is easy.

support.subject: As a power user, first-time setup is guided — clear instructions or a setup app walk me through registering the key with my accounts

citations.quote: Insert your Solo 2 into any USB port. No software or drivers required.
When prompted, touch the capacitive sensor on your Solo 2 to confirm.
